from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCategory(BaseModel):
    """Extracted info for a single document regarding its assigned category."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document")
    assigned_category: str | None = Field(description="The specific case category from the task list that this document belongs to")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    document_categories: list[DocumentCategory]
